issues.description: The GroverKakuro class constructor signature differs between the template and the solution: the template declares __init__(self, size: int) while the solution implements __init__(self) with no size parameter. The problem statement describes a fixed 2x2 Kakuro instance (no explicit constructor parameter), so this mismatch is likely unintentional and can confuse students about whether they must support a configurable puzzle size.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signatures consistent. Either (A) remove the unused size parameter from the template constructor and update the template docstring to match a fixed 2x2 puzzle (preferred given the problem text), or (B) update the solution and problem statement to accept and document a size parameter and implement size-aware initialization throughout the class. Ensure templates, solutions, and the problem description all use the same constructor signature.
